name: Minimax Prefix-Suffix Isomorphism
description: Replaced the direct simulation of a two-machine flow-shop (where completion times are defined by a state transition `max(top, prev_bottom)`) with its mathematical equivalent: minimizing the maximum prefix-suffix sum over all possible split points `k`. This completely removes the "jobs", "stages", and "parallel processing" vocabulary, forcing models to either independently rediscover Johnson's rule for this array minimax problem or fail.
